user.title: Connect Secvest
user.description: Host, for example https://192.168.2.22:4433. With newer Secvest firmware, you may need to enter the user code in the Username / Code field. You can set the polling intervals afterwards in the integration options.

reconfigure.description: Change the host and credentials used for the REST API. The integration reloads automatically after saving.

init.title: Secvest Options
init.description: Zones, faults, alarm state and the extensive wireless poll (RSSI/battery) each run independently on their own interval. For RSSI, optionally enter a separate restricted web user — RSSI polling stays disabled without web credentials.
